Upstream license:
  MIT No Attribution (see upstream LICENSE at the pinned revision)

The fixture adapts the upstream project's documented real-bundle shapes: Markdown concepts, YAML frontmatter with required `type`, display metadata, timestamps/provenance, nested concept paths, an `index.md`, and ordinary Markdown links between concepts. Business content, identifiers, and source URLs were rewritten as deterministic repository-owned test data so the E2E is offline and contains no AWS/customer data.

Skillet-specific additions exercise #35 acceptance cases that the upstream templates do not themselves provide as a ready-made bundle: source/verification/freshness metadata, one deliberately broken link, an unknown producer metadata key, and a deprecated concept used to prove delete reconciliation.

No upstream runtime, AWS service, or network access is required by the tests.
